Name: Rise and Shine - Configurable wake-up time
Author: Yoshify
Description:
Using mods that made my days longer left me thinking "Damn, do I really want to wait this long for the stores to open?"

This is my answer to that issue. By default, Rise and Shine will wake you up at 9:00am (As opposed to the default 6:00am), this is configurable through the RiseAndShine.ini included. 

Please note that this requires the latest [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] to use. Simply drag and drop the contents of the downloaded zip into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley directory.

Please feel free to report any issues, and as always - Enjoy!
